# Sahajanand Services

> Expert installation, erection and commissioning of plastic machinery. Material handling, loading/unloading, manufacturing, construction and refurbishment services across Asia Pacific, Africa, Europe and the Middle East.

## About
Sahajanand Services has 15+ years of experience in plastic machinery installation, erection and commissioning. We provide end-to-end industrial services including design & technology, HR recruitment, contract hire, new/used machine sale & purchase, and business consultancy.

## Services
- Installation, Erection & Commissioning
- Loading & Unloading
- Material Handling (crane & forklift hire)
- Design & Technology
- Manufacturing
- Construction
- Refurbishment
- New/Used Machine Sale & Purchase
- HR Recruitment & Contract Hire

## Industries Served
- Dairy & PET Filling Lines
- Flexible Packaging
- Printing & Lamination
- Boiler, Pipeline & Utilities
- Electrical & Automation
- Construction & Steel Structures

## Regions
- Asia Pacific
- Africa
- Europe
- Middle East
- Pan India
